highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: SonicWall warns of unpatched vulnerabilities in end-of-life management software and Texas A&M develops sovereign AI platform for research. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Russian state-backed hackers launch mobile cyberespionage campaign. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: DreamHost confirms data breach exposed FTP logins and webmail sessions. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
